verses.pali: Saṁyutta Nikāya 35.19
2. Yamakavagga
Paṭhamābhinandasutta
“Yo, bhikkhave, cakkhuṁ abhinandati, dukkhaṁ so abhinandati.
verses.english: “Mendicants, if you take pleasure in the eye, you take pleasure in suffering.

verses.pali: Yo dukkhaṁ abhinandati, ‘aparimutto so dukkhasmā’ti vadāmi.
verses.english: If you take pleasure in suffering, you’re not free from suffering, I say.

verses.pali: Yo sotaṁ …pe…
verses.english: If you take pleasure in the ear …

verses.pali: yo ghānaṁ …pe…
yo jivhaṁ abhinandati, dukkhaṁ so abhinandati.
Yo dukkhaṁ abhinandati, ‘aparimutto so dukkhasmā’ti vadāmi.
Yo kāyaṁ …pe…
yo manaṁ abhinandati, dukkhaṁ so abhinandati.
verses.english: mind, you take pleasure in suffering.

verses.pali: Yo dukkhaṁ abhinandati, ‘aparimutto so dukkhasmā’ti vadāmi.
verses.english: If you take pleasure in suffering, you’re not free from suffering, I say.

verses.pali: Yo ca kho, bhikkhave, cakkhuṁ nābhinandati, dukkhaṁ so nābhinandati.
verses.english: If you don’t take pleasure in the eye, you don’t take pleasure in suffering.

verses.pali: Yo dukkhaṁ nābhinandati, ‘parimutto so dukkhasmā’ti vadāmi.
verses.english: If you don’t take pleasure in suffering, you’re free from suffering, I say.

verses.pali: Yo sotaṁ …pe…
verses.english: If you don’t take pleasure in the ear …

verses.pali: yo ghānaṁ …pe…
yo jivhaṁ nābhinandati, dukkhaṁ so nābhinandati.
Yo dukkhaṁ nābhinandati, ‘parimutto so dukkhasmā’ti vadāmi.
Yo kāyaṁ …pe…
yo manaṁ nābhinandati, dukkhaṁ so nābhinandati.
verses.english: mind, you don’t take pleasure in suffering.

verses.pali: Yo dukkhaṁ nābhinandati, ‘aparimutto so dukkhasmā’ti vadāmi.”
verses.english: If you don’t take pleasure in suffering, you’re free from suffering, I say.”

verses.pali: Sattamaṁ.
